checks.message: Invoice duplicate guard must use strict write scanner
Receipt duplicate guard must use strict write scanner
Invoice write must enforce accounting period lock
Receipt write must enforce accounting period lock
Expense write must enforce purchase/tax period lock
Payment receipt creation must strict-parse business pack
Payment receipt creation must enforce period lock
Billing payment must use strict flow read and transactional receipt creation
Billing payment must not perform redundant non-transactional save after receipt transaction
Financial flow store writes must use rollback-capable transaction helper
Business document cloud sync should route through persistent outbox when available
Operational cloud sync should route through persistent outbox when available
Governance runtime must be wired in deployment HTML
Backup import must verify portable checksum before write and expose dry-run metadata
Governance persisted keys must be centralized in storage contracts
Governance transaction writes must not fall through to a second non-transactional localStorage write
Governance storage writes must fail closed through the transaction boundary instead of falling back to a second direct write
Synced Outbox operations must not be executed again
Concurrent same-browser Sync calls must share one in-flight operation
Outbox idempotency keys must not contain Date.now entropy for the same payload
Period Lock must validate through the pure governance core before persistence
Period Lock and Approval state must commit atomically with governance audit evidence
Interrupted sync must become uncertain instead of being auto-retried as if outcome were known
Period close checklist must surface uncertain sync state
